map.家庭自测血压怎么测更准？: How can a home blood pressure reading be more accurate?
map.是。偶发一次偏高可能受情绪运动影响；连续多日同一时段偏高或波动剧烈才更有临床意义: Yes. A single high reading may be affected by mood or exercise; readings that are repeatedly high at the same time of day over several days, or that swing sharply, carry more clinical meaning, and keeping a trend helps the doctor judge.
map.用于复诊时向医生展示用药前后变化，辅助调整方案。: Used at follow-up visits to show the doctor the change before and after the medication, helping adjust the plan.

map.血压血糖趋势 使用指南: Blood pressure and glucose trend usage guide
map.记录宜固定测量时段（晨起、睡前），避免单次偶然值误判。: Keep the measurement time fixed (morning and before bed) so a single accidental value is not misread.
map.记录每日血压与血糖读数，自动绘制波动趋势图，数据保存在本地浏览器，便于老人及家属: Record daily blood pressure and glucose readings, plot the fluctuation trend automatically, and keep the data in the local browser so elderly people and their families can track health changes over the long term.
map.趋势比单次数值重要吗？: Is the trend more important than a single reading?
map.静坐 5 分钟、袖带与心脏同高、间隔 1–2 分钟测两次取均值；固定时段（如晨起: Sit quietly for 5 minutes with the cuff at heart level, take two readings 1-2 minutes apart and average them; record at a fixed time (such as morning before medication or before bed) and avoid measuring right after alcohol, coffee or exercise.
map.高血压老人居家监测中，按时间记录收缩压/舒张压与心率，观察趋势与波动。: In home monitoring for elderly people with hypertension, record the systolic/diastolic pressure and heart rate against the time and watch the trend and fluctuations.
map.：取近 7–14 天数据，标注用药时段，向医生说明『晨峰』与『夜间』血压变化，比: : take the last 7-14 days of data, mark the medication times, and show the doctor the "morning peak" and "night-time" patterns, which are more informative than a single office reading.
map.：在工具中逐次录入『日期-时间-收缩压-舒张压-心率』，生成折线趋势；重点看连续: : enter "date - time - systolic - diastolic - heart rate" each time in the tool to get a line trend; the key is whether several consecutive days stay high or fluctuate too much.
